Name: Daily Fortune - Modern Control Theory
Description:
[b]Daily Fortune - Modern Control Theory[/b] is a lightweight [b]Content Patcher[/b] mod for [b]Stardew Valley[/b] that rewrites the TV daily fortune text in a dry, academic, and slightly absurd modern control theory style.
Instead of mystical language, the fortune forecast is presented with a system-analysis tone focused on stability, disturbances, feedback, and probability. The gameplay meaning stays the same, but the flavor and presentation are completely different.
[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Rewrites the daily fortune text in a modern control theory style
[*]Keeps the original gameplay meaning intact
[*]Lightweight and easy to install
[*]Built for Content Patcher
[*]Designed for players who enjoy dry humor, parody, and academic-style flavor text
[/list]
[b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI
[*]Content Patcher
[/list]
[b]Installation[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI
[*]Install Content Patcher
[*]Extract this mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder
[*]Launch the game with SMAPI
[/list]
[b]Compatibility[/b]
[list]
[*]Should be compatible with most mods
[*]Only edits text content
[*]No gameplay balance changes
[*]No save editing required
[/list]
[b]Note[/b]
This mod does not change the actual daily luck mechanics. It only changes how the forecast text is presented.
